turns.text: Hello! I’m doing well, thank you. How can I assist you today?
How do I create an e-mail signature?
Hold on a second while I look that up.

Open a new message, go to **Message > Signature > Signatures**, then on the **E-mail Signature** tab click **New**, name it, and enter your signature text.
You can format the text and add a business card, hyperlink, or picture, then click **OK**. Are you satisfied with the agent's response?
